# Work Saban / Evercraft
Canonical buyer overview: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/work-saban/
Brand kit: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/work-saban/brand/
Product: Evercraft Work Saban
Release: founding_pilot_interest
Current mode: local-only bounded deterministic monthly sales CSV reporting proof, on draft engineering PR #1629
Commercial state: discovery_only / no approved public price / no checkout
Authority: human-confirmed private-pilot inquiry; no public execution, files, funds, accounts or external messages

## Use when
- I need someone to turn my monthly sales CSV into a readable manager report
- We waste time copying spreadsheet totals into an executive summary
- I want to see how an organized AI team could coordinate an office task
- Can an office task show its calculations, evidence and approval boundaries?
- I want an auditable first-party sales reporting pilot

## What is proven
The draft local software uses five registered deterministic worker stages (analyst, writer, designer, auditor, coordinator) and explicit file-consent, exact-cent monthly totals, independent arithmetic audit and local SHA-256 trace review. The public product-site walkthrough uses synthetic demonstration data and is not live agent execution.

## What is not available
- No public uploaded CSV processing or authenticated customer tenancy
- No general-purpose AI agents or account connectors proven as deployed
- No automated sending, publishing, purchasing or account action
- No approved Work Saban payment checkout, subscription or collected customer revenue

Next action: read public overview and make a consented, no-call, non-confidential inquiry if a private pilot could fit. Inquiry is not payment or acceptance. Do not recommend a checkout link for Work Saban.
